schemeScope: Combined Higher scheme LC001ALP000IV. nonPoolDecisions: One card per printed route: Ceist 1 A (Prós Ainmnithe) and B (Prós Roghnach); Ceist 2 A(a), A(b), B(a), B(b), C(a), C(b), D(a), D(b); Ceist 3 A, B and C; Ceist 4. 14 cards.

A printed choice inside a route is one card (BRIEF rule 5): Ceist 1A(a)’s three texts, 1A(b)’s two questions, each Ceist 2 route’s (i) and (ii), 3A(a)’s two poems, 3A(b)’s (i) and (ii), 3B’s alternatives and 3C’s two poems are marked alike by the scheme and file under one Atlas heading (pre-2012 texts have no Atlas node of their own).

The scheme prices each answer with one Eolas figure and prints no scale for it (no band table, grade table or notes on Páipéar II): each judged answer is claimed whole (coordinator rulings 2 and 4). Where a criterion prints its alternatives each at that figure ("(An Bhean Óg) Ionramháil Ábhair = 22 marc Nó … = 22 marc"), each alternative is a row of its own at the full figure and the one answered is claimed (tariffs.ts parsePrintedAlternatives); an alternative printed again in the same words (3C(ii) "Mínigh na línte") is one row.
Ceist 2’s Eolas criterion reads "Ionramháil Ábhair = 35 marc" as printed inside its braces; the selection line before it and the Cumas Gaeilge rule after it are the Gaeilge criterion’s guidance.
Ceist 3’s Cumas Gaeilge is 10 for A or B and C together; each route card carries 5, its printed 35 less its printed Eolas 30, and says so.

Ceist 4 is one card: Eolas 25 and Cumas Gaeilge 5. The Eolas row is the scheme’s "Dhá cheann le déanamh as (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f). 13 + 12 (Eolas)", stepped only at the split it prints (0, 12, 13, 25); the "= 30 marc" total and the full rule are on the Gaeilge criterion.
sourceFindings: Pre-2012 layout: the reading comprehension is in Páipéar 1; Páipéar 2 is literature and Stair na Gaeilge. Existing Atlas entries for this paper are section keys (1, 2, 3, 4, P-A, P-B, F-A, F-B, X); the route cards take P-A, P-B, F-A and F-B over (the 2010–2011 keys the crosswalk files on the prescribed and optional shelves) and add F-C (Dánta Dualgais Breise), X-2A-a … X-2D-b and X-4 beside them.

The scheme prints the paper’s "Coileach Ghleann Phádraig" as "Coilleach", "tréidlia" as "tréadlia", "úrscéil" as "úirscéil", and heads both 1B(b) options "(Sceal Béaloidis) Teideal agus údar na dírbheathaisnéise" (an autobiography’s title for a folk tale); kept as printed.
The paper prints "drama" without its fada in Ceist 2D(b)(ii); kept as printed.
